title: Trying to Sleep (Vocadito 33)
reference_type: Analyst-proposed bar navigation, pending independent human aural and metrical review
reference_basis: Manual phrase and form reading of the two independent note transcriptions and source lyrics, with signal-level checks of breath gaps and ending from the source WAV. A 2.19 s opening span comes from plausible subdivision of the repeated motivic sentence, and the refrain’s four initial figures start about 1.18 s apart, yielding a possible 2.38 s 4/4 bar. The bar phase and meter are underdetermined. No human listening judgment is recorded.

uncertain_intervals.reason: The opening vocal phrase can be heard as a pickup. Absolute beat phase is unknown.
Second phrase enters around 2.89 s. The vocal attack alone does not mark a downbeat.
Lift begins after a breath gap. Bar phase can shift within the gap.
Free syllable placement around the lift. Grid uses approximate pulse interpolation.
Waveform breath gap and refrain entry delimit a section, not a measured downbeat.
Refrain variants imply a flexible pulse. Approximate 2.4 s bars are a navigation hypothesis.
The reprise phase is ambiguous after the preceding phrase resolves.
Final phrases are loose and tail to silence. Bar continuation is uncertain.
